title: Friction Design
hook: Skip the motivation. Put your gym shoes by the door.
statement: Behavior follows how easy something is to start.
explainer: Motivation swings. Friction stays. Remove one step and behavior shifts itself.
sop: Pick a habit to grow, one to cut.
Ease the good one. Block the bad.
equation_example: Motivation 7 ÷ Friction 2 = 3.5, nearly automatic. At 3 ÷ 6 = 0.5, friction wins.
question: Name one friction point you can remove today.
